description:
Real NVENC H.264 encoder backend (T-017a). Original implementation in commit 39484a3.

2026-05-19 Rounds 1–4 (uncommitted patches in helper/src/encoder/backends/nvenc/ffi.rs and mod.rs, plus helper/tests/encoder_selection.rs) fixed the probe-layer FFI bugs that caused T-021 rerun 5 to report `nvenc-api-create-failed:15`:

1. NVENC version-word formula corrected (`nvencapi_struct_version()` helper).
2. `NV_ENC_ERR_INVALID_VERSION` constant value corrected (7 → 15).
3. `NV_ENC_DEVICE_TYPE_CUDA` constant corrected (2 → 1; OPENGL → CUDA).
4. Six encode-path version constants centralised in ffi.rs.
5. `NV_ENC_INITIALIZE_PARAMS` struct re-laid-out to SDK 12.1 (packed bit-field flags, correct `maxMEHintCountsPerBlockRow` size, added `tuningInfo` and `bufferFormat`, adjusted `reserved1`).
6. `helper/tests/encoder_selection.rs` hardened with opt-in `COVE_NVENC_REQUIRE_AVAILABLE=1` strict mode so a probe regression cannot hide as a soft skip again.

Strict probe verification on RTX 4080 SUPER / driver 595.71.05: PASS. `encoder.selected` unblocked.

NOT in scope of this pass (Option B; tracked under T-025 / ISS-004):
- Set `tuningInfo` / `bufferFormat` to valid values in `configure()`.
- Audit / fix NV_ENC_PIC_PARAMS, NV_ENC_LOCK_BITSTREAM, NV_ENC_CREATE_INPUT_BUFFER, NV_ENC_CREATE_BITSTREAM_BUFFER, NV_ENC_LOCK_INPUT_BUFFER against SDK 12.1.
- Add size_of layout assertions across the NVENC structs.
- Make `nvenc_one_frame_shm_encode_produces_fmp4_fragment` pass (currently red with `nvenc-init-failed:12`).

Evidence: .story/handovers/2026-05-19-09 … 2026-05-19-12 stop-reports describe each round.
title: Implement real NVENC backend (T-017a)
